notes: The last piece of the tidy-up, and there is nothing to see. The hub was one 8,000-line file; it is now thirteen smaller ones grouped by what they do — chores, recipes, the wiki, the file share, printing, and so on. Nothing about how it behaves has changed: the same 125 addresses answer the same way, every page was checked against a recorded before-and-after, and the calendar views were compared date by date. The only difference is that the next time something needs fixing, it will be quicker to find.
